name: Jikkyou Namahame Ero Yakyuu
original_name: 実況ナマハメエロ野球
source:
This is a parody game of Konami's baseball game Power Pros

It was a problem that Konami disliked the adult game parody of its own game and that it featured a real Japanese professional baseball player, so it was threatened to sue and the sale was discontinued.
translation:
这是Konami棒球游戏Power Pros的模仿游戏

问题是科乐美不喜欢自己游戏的成人游戏模仿，并且以真正的日本职业棒球运动员为主角，因此受到威胁要起诉并停止销售。
